title: 170-odd Q-cleared witnesses of UFOs at sensitive sites

tellings.quote: See see if the 170-odd Q cleared, you know, people seeing UFOs around our most sensitive sites, shutting them down in certain cases,

plain: About 170 people holding Q clearance, the US security clearance for access to nuclear secrets, are said to have seen UFOs around America's most sensitive sites, and in some cases the objects are said to have shut those sites down. Michels raises this himself, in passing and without naming a source, while talking with the journalist Ross Coulthart. If true, it would mean unknown objects have been able to interfere with US nuclear facilities.
